environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.19 service mesh. The build-config-service runs in 'build-system' namespace with automatic sidecar injection. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a DENY action for requests where the source namespace does not match 'build-system' itself. However, the policy uses a workloadSelector matching app label 'build-config-service' and the DENY rule specifies source.namespace not in ['build-system']. The policy also has a secondary ALLOW rule for same-namespace traffic on port 8080. Note: the Istio PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mTLS mode for the namespace, meaning all traffic must present a valid SPIFFE identity. The AuthorizationPolicy evaluates after mTLS handshake using the verified source identity.
